terms.comment: Our description, after Erasmus’s sphaerulae precātōriae for rosary beads; precātōrius, of asking, is Donatus’s word (Lewis & Short). The Orthodox prayer rope is a knotted cord, usually of wool, for counting the Jesus Prayer; its Greek name means “knot-rope”. Its Western counterpart is the rosary.

sources: Lewis & Short: funiculus · Lewis & Short: precatorius
Morgan–Owens, Traupman and Levi–Bini have no word.
